info.title: ae/game-rules
info.description: The game-rules interface a turn engine drives, provided for Texas hold'em. Build it with createGameRules(deps, settings, pacing); methods named `GameRules.<name>` are members of the object it returns. A round is { hand, autoSteps }: JSON-safe and opaque to the engine. The chip ledger (ae/chip-ledger) is passed in and returned on every call that moves chips; the hand moves chips only through chip-ledger operations, so the ledger's sidePots, oddChipRule and minimumUnit settings decide the pots. Every operation is pure: it returns new values and never changes its arguments. Engine contract: at the start of a round call newRound with the players still in, keep the returned carry for the next round and write the returned ledger back; while phase(...).stage is acting, wait for a move, parseMove it and act it (or act defaultMove with auto true), writing the ledger back every time; while it is auto, call step after autoDelayMs; when it is over, outcome gives holdMs for the result pause, result for the clients and historyEntry for round-history; to cancel mid-round, voidRound returns every wager through the ledger. The lower layer, the hand state machine, is createHoldem; its members are the `Holdem.<name>` methods. Server: TypeScript `implementation/server/index.ts` (rules.ts, holdem.ts, pots.ts, types.ts). Client betting controls: TypeScript `implementation/web/betting.ts`; Swift `implementation/apple/Sources/Betting.swift` and Kotlin `ae.holdem` `Betting.kt` have BetRange (adjusted, allows, canSlide, kind, snap rounding down), betStep, betPresets, callIsAllIn and betIsAllIn.

methods.name: createGameRules
methods.description: The game-rules object for hold'em. Settings, lowest to highest precedence: DEFAULT_SETTINGS, the house rules (players.maximum, betting.minimum_opening_bet_big_blinds) when deps.rules is given, then `settings`.

methods.name: DEFAULT_SETTINGS
methods.description: The default hold'em settings.

methods.name: DEFAULT_PACING
methods.description: The default pacing.

methods.name: ACTION_TYPES
methods.description: The betting action types.

methods.name: GameRules.settings
methods.description: The settings in force.

methods.name: GameRules.pacing
methods.description: The pacing in force.

methods.name: GameRules.lower
methods.description: The lower layer the adapter drives (createHoldem with the same ranking, ledger and settings).

methods.name: GameRules.optionNames
methods.description: Option names a client may switch on and off; hold'em has none.

methods.name: GameRules.newRound
methods.description: Deal a new hand: a shuffled deck from card-deck, blinds sb and bb from the level schedule at input.level, stacks from the ledger, positions carried from the last round (or the button drawn with rng).

carry.description: The carry newRound returned last time, or null.

schema.description: A function () => number. Returns a number in [0, 1).

methods.name: GameRules.phase
methods.description: Where the round is: acting (one player is to move after settleMs; the first decision also waits for the cards to be dealt), auto (the next board card after autoDelayMs) or over.

methods.name: GameRules.parseMove
methods.description: Check and type a player's move message. needsTurn is false only for show.

methods.name: GameRules.act
methods.description: Apply one player's move: a betting action on their turn, or a voluntary show after the hand. unknownPlayer and notEnoughPlayers of the lower layer are reported as notAllowed.

params.name: move
params.description: A move message; parsed with parseMove.

auto.description: True when the engine acts for an absent or timed-out player.

methods.name: GameRules.defaultMove
methods.description: What the engine plays for a player who timed out: check if free, otherwise fold.

methods.name: GameRules.step
methods.description: Deal the next board card of a runout (flop, turn or river); settles after the river.

methods.name: GameRules.outcome
methods.description: The round's outcome once it is over, else null. holdMs: 0 voided, handOverMs uncontested, else by showdown kind (showdownMs, showdownKickerMs, showdownDrawMs).

methods.name: GameRules.voidRound
methods.description: Cancel the round: every wager goes back through the ledger. A round already over is returned as it is.

methods.name: GameRules.observation
methods.description: What the player may know, shaped as poker-strategy's DecisionInput (without style); null for someone not in the hand.

methods.name: GameRules.records
methods.description: One hidden record per player: the two hole cards, hidden from everyone else until shown (by index 0 and 1).

methods.name: GameRules.publicView
methods.description: The round for one viewer (null is a display) without the hole cards (they come from records) and without the legal moves (they come from legal). options is accepted and ignored.

methods.name: GameRules.legal
methods.description: What the viewer may do now; nothing while the table is paused.

methods.name: GameRules.prompt
methods.description: The line to show the viewer, or null.

methods.name: createHoldem
methods.description: The lower layer: the hand state machine.

methods.name: Holdem.settings
methods.description: The settings in force.

methods.name: Holdem.parseAction
methods.description: The wire message of a player's action, checked and typed. Not for lifecycle messages.

methods.name: Holdem.newHand
methods.description: Deal, post the blinds and find who acts first. Needs at least two players with chips.

methods.name: Holdem.legalActions
methods.description: What the player may do now.

methods.name: Holdem.apply
methods.description: One player's action: a betting action on their turn, or a voluntary show after the hand. May end the street, start the runout or settle the hand.

params.name: options
params.description: auto: the engine acted for the player.

methods.name: Holdem.autoAction
methods.description: What the engine plays for a player who timed out: check if free, otherwise fold.

methods.name: Holdem.runoutStep
methods.description: Stage runout: deal the next board cards (flop, turn or river); settles after the river.

methods.name: Holdem.isHandOver
methods.description: True once the hand is settled.

methods.name: Holdem.settle
methods.description: Finish a runout at once: deal what is left of the board and settle. Idempotent once over.

methods.name: Holdem.voidHand
methods.description: End the hand without a winner and give every contribution back (a cancelled game).

methods.name: Holdem.view
methods.description: What a viewer may see: the hand, each player's state, the viewer's legal actions, the result. viewerId null is a display that shows only what is face up.

methods.name: Holdem.stacks
methods.description: Chips each player holds behind (the same as the ledger's stacks).

methods.name: Holdem.attachLedger
methods.description: The hand with this ledger as its chip record. Every player of the hand must have the same stack, wager and folded mark in it.

methods.name: Holdem.chipsInPlay
methods.description: Stacks plus wagers; equals hand.chips at every point of a hand.

methods.name: awardPot
methods.description: Pay one pot to its best hands through the ledger's odd-chip rule. A pot with one eligible player is that player's (no hand name).

methods.name: showdownOf
methods.description: How the main pot was won at a showdown, for showing it; null when fewer than two were eligible.

schema.description: The main pot's award; undefined when there is none.

methods.name: stepFor
methods.description: Client: the unit a slider and quick amounts move in: the small blind, at least 1 (Swift and Kotlin betStep).

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Client: an amount rounded to the step and held inside the range. Browsers round to the nearest step; the native apps round down (BetRange.snap).

methods.name: presets
methods.description: Client: the quick amounts: the smallest allowed, half the pot, the pot (each after calling) and all-in (Swift and Kotlin betPresets, rounding down).

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Client: move an amount by a number of chips, held inside the range and safe against overflow (BetRange.adjusted).

methods.name: isAllowedAmount
methods.description: Client: whether a typed amount may be sent: a whole number inside the range (BetRange.allows).

methods.name: canSlide
methods.description: Client: whether a slider has anything to slide over.

methods.name: betKind
methods.description: Client: what the confirm button says for a chosen total: all-in at the maximum, otherwise bet or raise (BetRange.kind).

methods.name: callIsAllIn
methods.description: Client: whether calling puts the player all-in.

methods.name: betIsAllIn
methods.description: Client: whether a bet to this total puts the player all-in (stack and bet are what is behind and in front now).

Card.description: Two characters: rank 2-9, T, J, Q, K, A then suit c, d, h, s.

Stage.description: betting: someone may act; runout: nobody can bet any more, the board is being dealt; over: settled.

Action.description: bet carries the total for the street (opening bet, raise or all-in raise); show turns your own cards face up after the hand.

auto.description: True when the engine acted for an absent or timed-out player.

shown.description: Which of the two cards are face up.

kickers.description: Per hand, how many of its kickers to show after its combination.

PotRules.description: What a hand needs from the ledger's settings when it opens its own ledger.

deck.description: Cards still to deal, dealt from the end. Never sent to a client.

event.description: What the table is settling on: the deal, a new street or the last action (by lastActorId).

chips.description: Total chips in the hand at the start; constant until the hand is over.

ledger.description: Where every chip is; the players' stack, bet, totalIn and folded mirror it.

Hand.description: A hand as plain data: serialise it, store it, clone it.

positions.description: Positions of the previous hand, or null for the first hand (the button is then drawn with rng).

deck.description: A shuffled deck from card-deck, dealt from the end.

rng.description: A function () => number. Returns a number in [0, 1).

ledger.description: The ledger the chips move through; every player's stack must match it and nobody may have a wager open. Without one the hand opens its own from players and potRules.

bet.description: The allowed range of the street total; max is all-in.

show.description: Cards that may still be turned face up after the hand.

potTotal.description: Chips wagered this hand that are not yet in a pot, for display as the live pot.

hand.description: Best five-card hand once both cards are shown and the board has three or more cards.

cards.description: null entries are face down; your own cards and shown cards carry the card.

seats.description: Seats at the table: the odd chip of a split pot goes clockwise from the button around this many.

minimumOpeningBetBigBlinds.description: Minimum opening bet and minimum raise at the start of a street, in big blinds.

revealAtRunout.description: Turn every live hand face up as soon as nobody can bet any more.

seats.description: Seats at the table: the odd chip of a split pot goes clockwise from the button around this many.

minimumOpeningBetBigBlinds.description: Minimum opening bet and minimum raise at the start of a street, in big blinds.

revealAtRunout.description: Turn every live hand face up as soon as nobody can bet any more.

Pacing.description: Milliseconds the table gives each moment of a hand.

autoSteps.description: Runout steps taken, used to pace the first board card.

result.description: The HandOutcome with holdMs, shown to clients as lastResult.

HiddenRecord.description: private-views' HiddenRecord for one player's hole cards.

hand.description: Best five-card hand once both cards are shown and the board has three or more cards.

text.description: English text; the key and args are for the application's language files.

HandRankingLike.description: The members of a hand-ranking's HandRanking object hold'em calls.

compareEvaluations.description: A function compareEvaluations(a: Evaluation, b: Evaluation): Comparison.

winners.description: A function winners(contenders: { id: string; cards: Card[] }[], board: Card[]): { ids: string[]; evaluations: Record<string, Evaluation> }.

LedgerOperations.description: The chip-ledger functions the hand calls (the chip-ledger module).

commit.description: A function commit(ledger, id, amount): { ledger; committed }.

awardPot.description: A function awardPot(ledger, pot, winners: string[], button: number): Award.

DeckOperations.description: The card-deck function used: a shuffled deck whose draw pile is dealt from the end.

createShuffledDeck.description: A function createShuffledDeck(settings: { decks: number; jokers: boolean }, source: { shuffle<T>(items: readonly T[]): T[] }): { draw: Card[]; burned: Card[] }.

BlindSchedule.description: level-schedule's ScheduleApi bound to a schedule; hold'em reads values.sb and values.bb.

levelInfo.description: A function levelInfo(level: number): { values: Record<string, number> }.

RuleValues.description: rules-settings' RulesReader; hold'em reads players.maximum and betting.minimum_opening_bet_big_blinds.

GameRules.description: The object createGameRules returns; its members are the `GameRules.<name>` methods.

Holdem.description: The object createHoldem returns (TypeScript type GameRules in types.ts); its members are the `Holdem.<name>` methods.

BadSeats.message: seats is an integer of at least 2

BadOpening.message: minimumOpeningBetBigBlinds is an integer of at least 1

NotInRunout.message: holdem-rules: step needs a hand in its runout (<code>)

LedgerMismatch.message: holdem-rules: the ledger does not match the hand: <problem>
